children: Xi Zhang, through Hegro Well Pte. Ltd. and its parent Xi'an Gewei Petroleum Equipment Co., Ltd., disclosed a 74.0% stake in GOWell Energy Technology. The filing, dated Oct. 02, 2026, stems from a business combination that issued 28,571,430 ordinary shares to Hegro. The move gives Zhang significant governance rights tied to his controlling position.

Hegro gained the right to appoint half of GOWell Energy Technology’s board while Hegro, its affiliates, and acting‑in‑concert holders keep at least 40% of the outstanding shares. As the filing states, Hegro can “appoint and maintain in office such number of directors as constitutes 50% of the Issuer’s board of directors,” and can remove and replace those directors.

Hegro and Inflection Point Fund I LP may also earn up to 20,000,000 additional shares in three tranches if GOWell hits EBITDA targets for 2026, 2027, and 2028, giving the group more potential upside. Beyond these rights, the investors do not outline concrete plans today but keep flexibility to adjust their holdings.

Xi Zhang is a Chinese industrial entrepreneur who controls Xi'an Gewei Petroleum Equipment Co., Ltd. and serves as Chairman of GOWell Energy Technology. He focuses on building operating companies in energy equipment and uses majority ownership to drive strategy and governance. Zhang typically invests for long-term control and seeks value through industrial growth and efficiency.
